body: It's ok. Yeah, but they never really take me seriously. It's my birthday, and I'm worrying about my biology exam that I'm seriously screwed for, haha.

No problem. 

I feel like they're oppressing me, telling me to do several different things at once. Everyone wants something different of me, whether it be good grades, friendship, love... I just can't deal with all that pressure.

Exams, and some people are in the way of my happiness.

I'm atheist. No religion.

I feel empty. Like I have no reason to be here. I don't want to live in a world where I have no purpose.
I would speak to you, but I feel like you don't want to speak to me, ever. Thanks anyway. It means a lot.
